messages.subject: Pump shaft HX (part:320070) – material and energy cost basis
messages.body:
Hallo Herr Dralveck,

Thank you for the improved offer. Your costing may still reflect the 2022 peak, and the main input indices have fallen since then.

Stainless bar index AS-14404 fell from 3182.6744 (idx:AS-14404@2026-06) to 3007.8019 (idx:AS-14404@2026-09), a change of -5.49%.
Energy index PPI-D351 fell from 140.5 (idx:PPI-D351@2025-11) to 123.7 (idx:PPI-D351@2026-04), a change of -11.96%.
PPI-C2431 fell from 131.9 (idx:PPI-C2431@2026-05) to 129.1 (idx:PPI-C2431@2026-08), a change of -2.12%.

We propose three complete packages for 4,200 pc per year over 24 months. One offers 30-day payment, which addresses your earlier concern about overdue invoices. Could you make one of them your primary offer?

Gruß
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing

messages.subject: Re: Pump shaft HX (part:320070) – material and energy cost basis
messages.body:
Hallo,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We have clarified this internally and can move further on the price. As to the index change data you cited, we did not know that - a fair point. Moin, I checked your numbers on the material and energy indices, and you are right, they have come down. Material accounts for about 34 % of our cost; more detail we do not share. Since you offered 30 days payment, which really helps us out, I sharpened my pencil and can do €29.50 for the 35 days lead time. So our offer is a price of €29.50 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, Lieferzeit 35 days. Let's lock this in so we can get the machines running.

Gruß
Andreas Dralveck
Owner, Zerspanung Dralveck GmbH

messages.subject: Re: RFQ: pump shaft for the new HX series
messages.body:
Hello,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the rival quote data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. Our price follows our main cost drivers: LCI-C, PPI-C2431, AS-14404, PPI-D351.

To show we're really eager to get this going, I can do 31.00 EUR. But we gotta stick to 52 days lead time and 45 days payment, 90 days is just too long for us to wait for the money. Our standard Zahlungsziel is 45 days net. Faster payment is welcome; we can reflect it in the price.

Right now, our main offer stands at a price of €35.00 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, Lieferzeit 35 days. Alternatively, with standard terms of Zahlungsziel 45 days net and Lieferzeit 52 days: €31.00 per unit. This offer stays valid for 30 days.

Kind regards
Jana Procházková
Export Manager, Strojírna Hrvelec s.r.o.

Freight Forwarder: Our Lieferzeit is 35 days. With overtime we can deliver in 35 days, at a premium.
